In [20]:
# Plot
df = drivers[drivers['gene_name'].isin(wnt)]
df = df.sort_values("OPC Schwann-primed_corr", ascending=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

# Horizontal lines for CIs
ax.hlines(y=df["gene_name"], xmin=df["OPC Schwann-primed_ci_low"], xmax=df["OPC Schwann-primed_ci_high"], color="black")

# Points for correlations
ax.plot(df["OPC Schwann-primed_corr"], df["gene_name"], "o", color="black")

# Vertical reference line at zero correlation
ax.axvline(x=0, color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)

# Labels
ax.set_xlabel("Correlation")
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title("Forest Plot of Correlations")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("figures/forest_plot_correlation_driver_genes_cellrank_SC_cellfate_drivers_WNT_genes.pdf")
plt.show()
